description:
Pegma brings the classic Peg Solitaire challenge to your mobile device. Jump pegs over each other, clear the board, and try to finish with a single peg left — simple to learn, satisfying to master.

Play through a clean, modern interface with smooth controls and multiple board layouts. Whether you want a quick brain teaser or a focused logic challenge, Pegma keeps every move clear and every level engaging.

Pegma is completely free and open source — no ads, no hidden purchases, just pure puzzle play.
promotionalText: Master the timeless Peg Solitaire challenge — free, open source, with no ads or hidden purchases.
